introHtml: Klean Kanteen is known for its durable, stainless steel drinkware, but their lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer the same rugged, eco-conscious quality. Made with recycled materials and insulating linings, these bags keep meals fresh and organized for employees on the go. Perfect for safety managers equipping crews or HR directors rolling out sustainable welcome kits, they combine function with a clean, minimalist look. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that lasts.
